steps: 1. uploadUserImage() src/services/storage.ts:89 -> Supabase Storage user-images bucket
2. analyzeAndSearchPlaylist() src/services/playlist.ts:112 -> invoke Edge Function 1 with JWT
3. Edge Function 1 auth+rate limit supabase/functions/analyze-and-search/index.ts:84-133 (userId from JWT only, never client body)
5. signed image URL, 5 min TTL index.ts:181-193
6. analyzeImage() gpt.ts:481 GPT-4o Vision call with SYSTEM_PROMPT + CURATION_LANES_PROMPT embedded
7. primary_lane_id validated against VALID_LANE_IDS, SafeError thrown if invalid/missing (no fallback default)
8. selectVerifiedCatalogTracks(laneId) musicCatalog.ts:7191 - fast path, no YouTube API call, currently always succeeds (701/701 tracks verified)
9. sequenceCatalogTracksWithAnchors() sequencing.ts:176 - anchor opener/mood-lock picks + 6-stage energy arc reorder
10. fallback: selectCatalogTracks (any track in lane) then youtube_fallback (searchYouTubeTracks with GPT's own playlist[]) if <5 verified tracks
12. insertTracks() db.ts:150 writes tracks table rows (rank/title/artist/reason/youtube_video_id/youtube_video_url/thumbnail_url only)
13. Edge Function 1 returns {playlist_id}, status stays 'searching' (Edge Function 1 never sets creating/created)
14. ResultScreen: getPlaylistResult() src/services/playlist.ts:45 reads playlists+tracks, builds signed image URL, laneId NOT sent to client
15. Playback: no in-app player - TrackItem/ActionButtons open YouTube via Linking/window.open
16. optional, feature-flagged off: Edge Function 2 create-youtube-playlist searching->creating->created
17. optional: create-share-link/get-shared-playlist -> SharedResultScreen (public, no auth, excludes user_id/image_storage_path)

migrationImpact.note: See docs/music-system-audit.md section J for the full table (18 possible changes x 9 impact dimensions). Summary of highest-risk items:
highRiskChanges: Remove fixed lane membership as primary selection rule - touches curationLanes.ts, gpt.ts SYSTEM_PROMPT (~700 lines hand-written), index.ts steps 7-9, sequencing.ts, db.ts schema, loadingContent.ts

Add per-track atmosphere stats - requires promoting GPT's currently-discarded STEP 3.5 visual profile into an actual output field; 701 tracks need atmosphere backfill from scratch, no existing signal approximates this at catalog level

Change image analysis from lane selection to atmosphere output - full SYSTEM_PROMPT rewrite, GptResponse type change, db.ts field mapping change, index.ts selection algorithm rebuilt from equality-filter to similarity-search (no such algorithm exists in repo today)
Search across entire catalog (drop lane-scoped filtering) - replaces O(lane) filtering with a similarity/embedding-ranking algorithm class that does not exist anywhere in the current codebase
